searchText: Can we get this merged when possible, please <@412614104222531604> https://github.com/ethpandaops/ethereum-package/pull/1345. Is there anyone else that is picking up your management of ethereum-package / kurtosis repos whilst you're OOO? I'd rather not disturb you whilst you're OOO, maybe I can just work on forks for now. cc <@199561711278227457> if Barnabus is away, for guidance cc <@808969530608451584> <@466102668138512394> it looks like the reth-zisk guest is returning a public input that does not match the expected public input and thats resulting in some verification issues downstream when proofs are gossiped. Do you do any internal consistency checking of the public input? I'm using: - ghcr.io/eth-act/zkboost/zkboost-server:0.3.0 - ghcr.io/eth-act/ere/ere-server-zisk:0.6.1-cuda - https://github.com/eth-act/ere-guests/releases/download/v0.7.0/stateless-validator-reth-zisk cc: <@774033563732541451> Uhm, yeah we have ~25 mainnet blocks integration tests in ere-guest CI, so that sounds wierd. Also, the calculation is pretty much [hash_tree_root of whatever is received as input](https://github.com/eth-act/ere-guests/blob/main/crates/stateless-validator-reth/src/guest.rs#L57). Is this mismatch maybe related to output length? Because there is a quirk that I commented [here](https://github.com/eth-act/ere-guests/pull/27#discussion_r2975736758) reg how Zisk works today that might nto be obvious. i.e. Zisk pads the public input to 256 bytes so doesn't fully respect exactly what the guest program wrote If the public input length isn't the prob, maybe also worth checking if libssz which is the crate we use in the guest program matches the same hash_tree_root of whatever the CL is using (I assume ethereum_ssz maybe). Ah the public values padding of `zisk@0.16.0` is probably the issue, will fix that soon thank you! 🙏 thanks for the context, that makes sense Published `ghcr.io/eth-act/zkboost/zkboost-server:{0.3.1,latest}` with the verification fix 🙏 merged!

excerpts.author: jsign
excerpts.content:
Uhm, yeah we have ~25 mainnet blocks integration tests in ere-guest CI, so that sounds wierd. Also, the calculation is pretty much [hash_tree_root of whatever is received as input](https://github.com/eth-act/ere-guests/blob/main/crates/stateless-validator-reth/src/guest.rs#L57). 
Is this mismatch maybe related to output length? Because there is a quirk that I commented [here](https://github.com/eth-act/ere-guests/pull/27#discussion_r2975736758) reg how Zisk works today that might nto be obvious. i.e. Zisk pads the public input to 256 bytes so doesn't fully respect exactly what the guest program wrote

excerpts.author: jsign
excerpts.content: If the public input length isn't the prob, maybe also worth checking if libssz which is the crate we use in the guest program matches the same hash_tree_root of whatever the CL is using (I assume ethereum_ssz maybe).
